About

Gulberg ke dil mein ek pur-sukoon thehrao

The Residency Hotel Lahore ke mashhoor Gulberg ilaqay mein, Zafar Ali Road ke qareeb waaqay hai. 43 kamron par mushtamil ye 4-star hotel karobari safar ho ya khandani chhutti — dono ke liye ek mukammal intekhab hai.

Mehman yahan swimming pool, gym, sauna aur spa se lutf andoz ho sakte hain, Café 39 aur hotel ke restaurant mein khana kha sakte hain, aur art gallery aur conference rooms ki sahoolat bhi maujood hai.
